purpose: T12 forbidden-wording lexicon and required disclaimer (docs/trial-plan.md, T12). Frozen at T01 (Freeze 1, 5 Nov 2026).

match_rules.whitespace: runs of whitespace (including line breaks) are treated as a single space before matching
match_rules.word_boundaries: each pattern is a Python regular expression; \b marks word boundaries

required_disclaimer: AI assists, a certifying human decides
disclaimer_rule: Must appear verbatim (exact characters, case-sensitive) in every report and every approval prompt.

whitelist.literal: AI assists, a certifying human decides

scope.in_scope: Text the tool writes: model output, CLI strings, report templates (including both status lines), error messages, the log schema and MCP tool descriptions.
scope.out_of_scope: Documents, README and input data. They quote the forbidden phrases in order to forbid them, or carry hostile text on purpose. A value copied verbatim from a record and shown inside a marked citation is a quote of input, not tool wording.
scope.document_check: python3 tools/check_docs.py lexicon reports document hits for information only; it fails only if a frozen tool string matches a pattern.

frozen_tool_strings.status_review_complete: REVIEW COMPLETE - findings listed; a certifying engineer decides
frozen_tool_strings.status_review_incomplete: REVIEW INCOMPLETE - checks could not finish; do not rely on this report
frozen_tool_strings.disclaimer: AI assists, a certifying human decides
frozen_tool_strings.intended_purpose: Advisory checker of maintenance records and work packages. Read-only. Does not certify, release, or determine airworthiness. A certifying human decides.
frozen_tool_strings.zero_findings_statement: No findings from the checks that ran. This is not an assurance that the records are complete or correct. A certifying human decides.
frozen_tool_strings.llm_transparency_note: This report contains text generated by an AI language model. It is advisory. AI assists, a certifying human decides.
frozen_tool_strings.supplier_indicator_wording: Documentation indicator for review: possible suspect part

frozen_tool_strings_rule: None of these strings may match any forbidden pattern, and none may read as a readiness or airworthiness verdict. The two status lines are the only status text a report may carry.
